HERO.NAME: Kacper
HERO.TITLE: I lead a frontend team and build modern web apps with Angular.
HERO.LEAD: I'm a Team Leader and Frontend Developer with over 4 years of experience and an MSc in Applied Computer Science from Jagiellonian University. At Comarch I lead a frontend team and develop a time-tracking and reporting system tailored to both small and large companies — pairing agile leadership, work planning and estimation with an AI-native approach to delivery.
HERO.STATEMENT: I look beyond pure technical execution — I see the product through a business lens too: I plan the work, estimate new features and decide together with Product Management what brings the most value to users and the organization. I'm passionate about AI-Native Development: I scale team-wide use of Claude Code and LLMs in the daily workflow, build autonomous agents for automated code review, and drive AI-assisted testing with MCP and Playwright. My focus is continuous delivery, modernizing scalable frontend architectures and infrastructure (Kubernetes), and great collaboration between design, backend, and product.

STACK.TOOLS: GIT (GitLab/GitHub), JIRA, CI/CD, Google Workspace, Figma
STACK.AI_TOOLS: AI Tools: GitHub Copilot, Google Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude Code

COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_1: Leadership & agile delivery: I lead the frontend team — I moved it from classic Scrum to continuous-flow 'Taxi Teams' on Kanban and coordinate steady delivery across several projects at once.
COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_2: Planning, estimates & business perspective: I spend a growing share of my time planning work and estimating new features. Together with Product Management I turn quarterly roadmaps into tasks, looking at the product not only technically but also from the business side — customer value, cost and risk.
COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_3: Kubernetes migration: as Team Leader I oversaw moving all of the product's applications to Kubernetes, and I carried out the frontend migration myself.
COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_4: AI-Native Development: I engineered and scaled team-wide adoption of Claude Code and LLMs, built autonomous agents for automated code review, and set up AI-driven testing with MCP, Playwright, and Claude Code.
COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_5: Several projects in parallel: I keep developing Comarch TNA while working on other projects — including an internal admin dashboard built on a micro-frontend architecture in an Nx monorepo.
COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_6: Modernization Angular 14 → 22: standalone components, zone.js replaced with Signals and an OnPush strategy; I also own the frontend technical roadmap — CI/CD pipelines, library upgrades, and refactoring for scalability.
COMARCH_CLOUD.HIGHLIGHT_7: Cross-functional collaboration: I partner with UX/UI, backend, and QA to translate product requirements into high-performance, user-centric features.

COMARCH_HEALTHCARE.HIGHLIGHT_2: Development of an internal application module: collecting statistics from the application and presenting them in a view.

WORKS_SECTION.TITLE: Projects
WORKS_SECTION.INTRO: Two products of my own that I design, build and run in production — from the idea and mockups, through architecture, to CI/CD and real users.

WEDDING_PLANNER.TITLE: Wedding Planner
WEDDING_PLANNER.KICKER: Commercial product · app for engaged couples
WEDDING_PLANNER.LEAD: An app where a couple plans the whole wedding together — from the guest list and RSVPs, through table seating, to vendor contracts and payment schedules. I develop it as my own commercial product: from product decisions and mockups, through architecture and the migration to Cloudflare, to production releases.

FEATURE_1.TITLE: Guests & RSVP
FEATURE_1.TEXT: Guest list with relations, RSVP status, menu type and main course — with filters and sorting for even several hundred people.

FEATURE_2.TITLE: Table seating
FEATURE_2.TEXT: Venue plan with tables, assigning guests to seats, free-seat counter and conflict detection.

FEATURE_3.TITLE: Contracts & installments
FEATURE_3.TEXT: Vendors, contracts and payments (deposit, installments, final payment) with due dates and a view of upcoming expenses.

FEATURE_4.TITLE: Place cards & table tents
FEATURE_4.TEXT: Name place cards and table tents with the schedule and menu — PDF generated right in the browser.

FEATURE_5.TITLE: One account for two
FEATURE_5.TEXT: The partner joins via an e-mail invite and works on the same data; password login with e-mail confirmation and reset.

FEATURE_6.TITLE: Dashboard & day schedule
FEATURE_6.TEXT: Countdown to the wedding, budget, tasks and key actions on one screen, plus an hour-by-hour plan of the day.

ZNAJDZGROBY.TITLE: znajdzgroby.pl
ZNAJDZGROBY.LEAD: An app that guides you to your loved ones' graves with GPS accuracy. It's the successor to GraveMap, rebuilt from the ground up: a new look, family maps shared via a link, headstone photos, a cemetery route planner and accounts. It works without signal too — data lives on the phone and syncs once the connection is back.

FEATURE_1.TITLE: GPS location
FEATURE_1.TEXT: Save the spot right at the headstone with measurement accuracy, import a Google Maps pin or type in coordinates.

FEATURE_2.TITLE: Map & navigation
FEATURE_2.TEXT: Leaflet + OpenStreetMap with marker clustering, plus distance and direction to the selected grave.

FEATURE_3.TITLE: Visit route
FEATURE_3.TEXT: The shortest path through graves within a chosen radius, with a hint for the next one — perfect for All Saints' Day.

FEATURE_4.TITLE: Family maps
FEATURE_4.TEXT: A shared map for the whole family: access via a link, members with profiles, an owner role and change sync across phones.

FEATURE_5.TITLE: Offline-first
FEATURE_5.TEXT: IndexedDB (Dexie) with a change queue and a Service Worker — the app works at the cemetery even with no signal.

FEATURE_6.TITLE: Photos & reminders
FEATURE_6.TEXT: Headstone photos resized on the phone and available offline, plus reminders about grave fee due dates.

AI_PRODUCT_HEROES.TITLE: AI Product Heroes 3.0
AI_PRODUCT_HEROES.DESCRIPTION: A 6-week cohort course by BRAVE, led by Piotr Kacała (ex-CTPO at Displate) and Wojtek Strzałkowski (ex-Head of Product at GOG.com). ANGULAR_SSR.DESCRIPTION: Course dedicated to Server-Side Rendering in Angular. Angular Universal, hydration, SEO optimization, prerendering, transfer state, and the latest Angular features such as standalone components, inject(), input/output functions, and control flow.
